description: Returns what forming a company costs, priced live, with `includes` listing what the price covers. Creates nothing and charges nothing. Use this whenever the user asks about price instead of quoting a figure from memory — it is ONE flat all-inclusive one-time payment, the same in every state, so there is no plan, no cadence, no add-on and no second charge to describe. The `state` argument is accepted for compatibility and does not change the price.
name: formation_get_formation_quote
title: Get Formation Quote
